title: SOC2 rapid evidence checklist & morning scratchpad
content:
Morning scratchpad — quick, ephemeral notes. Use this for runbook fragments + things to push to the SOC2 evidence folder later.

Top priorities (today, 2-3 hour blocks):
- [ ] Finish evidence packet for encryption-at-rest (EVID-enc-2026-03): collect KMS key policy, rotation schedule, backup logs (estimate 90m).
- [ ] Vendor review: Datadog (SOC doc missing last 12 months of attestations) — draft request email to vendor security contact (Zoe to review).
- [ ] Reconcile access review spreadsheet: confirm last 3 months of IAM role changes (sheet: infra/iam-access-2026).
- [ ] Quick policy edit: retention_policy.md — clarify S3 lifecycle for logs older than 180 days (10-20m).

Evidence checklist (quick IDs I use):
- EVID-enc-2026-03: KMS policy, key rotation proof, CMK ARN, KMS audit log excerpt (aws cloudtrail snippet).
- EVID-iam-2026-03: access review CSV, manager approvals (emails), deprovision events.
- EVID-change-2026-03: change control ticket list (release-engineering), PRs linked, approvals.
- EVID-incident-2026-03: incident report template, timeline, blameless review link.

Notes to self / actions to attach to each evidence item:
- attach Confluence page snapshot (export PDF) 
- screenshot of IAM console + timestamped CloudTrail event ID
- annotate why this proves the control (one-line justification)

Vendor quick notes (short):
- Datadog: missing SOC2 type II for 2025 — reach out. If no response by 3/20, escalate to procurement.
- Sentry: ok, but need updated BAA (legal working on). Add to vendor-attestations tracker.
- Vault (Hashi): hosted managed — ask for KMS integration docs + rotation proof.

Policy TODOs (small, actionable):
- retention_policy.md: add example lifecycle rule and cite cost estimate (linked to infra-costs/2026).
- onboarding-checklist: add step for MFA verification video + screenshot (helps evidence).
- encryption-guidance: short blurb about envelope encryption for sensitive embeddings.

Meeting / handoff notes (standup 9:30):
- tell Zoe: need review on vendor email before sending.
- tell Marcus: hand off IAM reconciliation rows 12-34 (I flagged).
- blockers: waiting on legal for BAA template for Sentry (ping legal@).

Temp snippets to paste into requests/emails: 
- "Hi [vendor], we are performing our SOC2 evidence collection and need your most recent SOC2 Type II report plus any attestation of key management. Could you share the report or point to where it is hosted? Thanks — Riley, Redwood Inference."

Quick commands I sometimes paste into evidence notes (keep here for copy/paste):
- AW S CloudTrail snippet: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:... --start-time 2026-02-01 --end-time 2026-03-13 --max-items 5
- IAM changes CSV export path: s3://redwood-infra-docs/iam-reports/2026/03/access-review.csv

Questions / unresolved:
- Do we accept vendor SOC2 reports older than 12 months for now, or require 12-month rolling? (Default: require <=12m; confirm with legal.)
- Where should I store annotated screenshots vs raw evidence? (current practice: raw in evidence/raw/, annotated in evidence/packets/)

End-of-day handoff (fill before leaving):
- what I completed: 
  * KMS policy PDF attached to EVID-enc-2026-03 (yes/no) -> __
  * Email to Datadog sent -> __
  * IAM rows reconciled -> __

Notes-to-self: keep this doc ephemeral — transfer any completed items to shared_drives/company/security/soc2/evidence/ with names matching EVID-*. If something is stuck >48h, escalate in #sec-compliance with short summary.

Random scrap / brain dump (may move later):
- Consider a short template for vendor request emails (1 para + list of items) so we standardize requests and speed up follow-ups.
- Could add a small automation to fetch CloudTrail snippets for a list of ARNs and dump to S3 (ticket idea for platform-engineering).

End.
